ERASMUS+ KA210-ADU · 2026–2028

About CREATE & CARE

Creative Adult Education for Mental Well-Being and Inclusion — an 18-month small-scale partnership connecting adult educators and communities in Germany, Portugal and Türkiye.

OUR AIMS

Why we came together

Across Europe, many adults over 25 experience loneliness, social isolation or everyday emotional strain—whether after moving country, caring for family, facing unemployment or living in remote or rapidly changing neighbourhoods.

CREATE & CARE equips adult educators with gentle, practical creative methods so community centres and local NGOs can offer welcoming spaces where adults express themselves, build peer networks and take part in local cultural life.

What we build together (Sep 2026 – Feb 2028)

  • Train 12 adult educators (4 from each partner country) during an intensive training week in Madeira.
  • Facilitate local workshops for 60 adults 25+ (20 per city, at least half with fewer opportunities) in Bonn, Funchal and Eskişehir.
  • Publish an open-access Methods Manual in four chapters (Drawing, Storytelling, Drama, Music) plus ready-to-run session templates.
  • Run four awareness campaigns and host three local exhibitions + one permanent VR gallery to destigmatise conversations around mental well-being.
WHY ART?

Four creative doors into conversation

Sitting in a circle and being asked “How is your mental health?” stops many adults at the door. Creative activities lower the barrier:

  • Drawing & visual postcards: putting colours and shapes on paper when words feel stiff—especially helpful across different first languages.
  • Storytelling: sharing everyday memories, objects and places that anchor identity and resilience.
  • Drama & role-play: stepping into playful group exercises that build empathy and confidence.
  • Music & rhythm: listening and creating shared rhythms that connect a room without needing musical training.
THE NON-CLINICAL PROMISE

Learning and community, not therapy

CREATE & CARE is an adult education project, not medical treatment, psychotherapy or crisis counselling.

Our facilitators are trained adult educators and youth/community workers. Every workshop begins with clear, warm boundaries: participants always choose what they share, never dissect trauma, and focus on peer learning, creativity and everyday well-being.

At every local workshop and on our Contact page, we provide direct signposting to professional local mental-health and crisis support services in Germany, Portugal and Türkiye.

WHO THIS IS FOR

Our three target groups

GROUP 01 · LEARNERS

Adults aged 25+

60 direct workshop participants across Bonn, Madeira and Eskişehir. At least half are adults with fewer opportunities—including migrants and refugees, unemployed adults, family carers, older adults or people living in isolated areas. No previous art experience is needed.

GROUP 02 · EDUCATORS

Adult educators & facilitators

12 directly trained facilitators plus community trainers, volunteers and language/integration teachers across Europe who use our free Methods Manual, session templates and campaign kits.

GROUP 03 · STAKEHOLDERS

Local NGOs & municipalities

Community centres, cultural venues, social services and municipal adult-education providers who refer learners, co-host our three-week exhibitions and attend the February 2028 multiplier conferences.
